feedback.payload: Adopt versioned NeedleProjection + strict validator + provenance-bound Clay ToolProposal. Needle remains sole intentional semantic foreign body but never authority.
Add NSO-001..010 regression family including fail-open constrained decoder, schema dialect, normalization collision, context truncation, config strictness and checkpoint trust.
Clay capability descriptors must expose a deterministic projection surface and typed proposal/result boundary without embedding provider/Needle schema as canonical semantics.
Safe-Effect/capability authority remains outside Needle; invalid/uncertain route becomes Clay abstain/escalate observation.
Persist Needle provenance tuple: source/model/tokenizer/registry/projection/input hashes plus raw route, validation result and eventual effect receipt linkage.
Needle route confidence/activation is not truth or authority; graph linkage records proposal ancestry and outcome only.
No direct GWT mechanism delta; Needle route may be an input proposal but does not alter current workspace causal contract.
No new hyperposition semantics; preserve proposal provenance if routing candidates later participate in set-valued state.
No emergence promotion; routing accuracy or agreement is not emergence evidence.
External Needle source gap is source-level closed at 6fdddb8; full exact tokenizer/model/Cactus runtime differential remains open and should be visible as a concrete gate rather than vague TODO.
